notes.title: Cho Dengeki Stryker Trading Cards Live!
notes.notes:
We're proud to announce that the Steam Trading Cards for Cho Dengeki Stryker are now live!

Collect cards featuring each of the Strykers to earn your badges, which are modeled after the Balboran Empire's military ranks! The emoticons feature character expressions from the game, and you can earn some awesome, electrically charged Backgrounds for your profile!
